title: 2019-08-22 MoM Power BI cost overview POC
content:
Date

Attendees

Absent

Goals

Decide on the next step for creating an overview of IPEX cloud accounts and related costs


Discussion items

TimeItemWhoNotes
5minImplementation of basic cost overview for IPEX Azure accounts in CBF tenant

We looked at the POC views that Maria created in Power BI.

The initial views are good enough for the first version.

We need to solve how to get more than 2 months history for detailed statistics. Currently only aggregated date for all of CBF is is available more than 2 months back. The goal is to have a 12 month history to be able to have good overview of cost development.

We need to solve how to implement authorization so that a user only have access to relevant data.

We need to have at least 10 Power BI licenses

Where is data stored?



CBF now has a GCP tenant available. This means that if we have need to evaluate GCP specific functionality CBF will be able to provide a GCP project moving forward. Initial governance FW to be set up for Naming standards, IAM, Billing etc.

Working on plan for next year e.g. deprecate Cloudyn and focus on the billing portal in Azure as well as monthly billing e-mail containing Azure Subscription cost over the past 3 months.

Action items

1 complete Initiate pilot cost overview in Power BI including licenses. (Cost for 20 Power BI Pro licenses added in BC for Cloud & Compute Area, FY20) 42 complete  Will book meeting med Components that has the most Power BI licenses currently in INTER. As input to which type of licence we should go for 44 complete  Investigate data availability and authorization see above 43 complete Book next meeting
